name: Lesson 37 · Whose: the genitive, des Vaters, wegen

cards.front: That is **my father's** car.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. The genitive says whose. It follows the noun it belongs to; der-words take des or -es and add -s to the noun.

cards.front: The name **of the street** is long.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. die-words take der in the genitive, and the noun stays the same.

cards.front: The end **of the film** was sad.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. der Film → des Films: the article and the noun both mark it.

cards.front: At the beginning **of the year** I worked a lot.
cards.back: Am Anfang **des Jahres** habe ich viel gearbeitet.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. Short words often take -es: des Jahres.

cards.front: At the end **of the month** I have no money.
cards.back: Am Ende **des Monats** habe ich kein Geld.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. der Monat → des Monats.

cards.front: **In the middle of the week** the cinema is cheap.
cards.back: Mitte **der Woche** ist das Kino billig.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. die Woche → der Woche. Mitte der Woche: midweek.

cards.front: The price **of the ticket** is high.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. die Fahrkarte → der Fahrkarte.

cards.front: What is the address **of the hotel**?
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. das Hotel → des Hotels: das-words take des too.

cards.front: Do you have the number **of the doctor**? (one friend)
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. After -t, the -es is easier to say: des Arztes.

cards.front: **My sister's** flat is big.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. Possessives take ein's endings: meiner for a die-word. German puts the owner after the thing.

cards.front: I like the colour **of the car**.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. das Auto → des Autos.

cards.front: What is the title **of the book**?
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. das Buch → des Buches.

cards.front: That is **the colleague's** car.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. der Kollege takes -n, not -s: des Kollegen.

cards.front: That is **his brother's** friend.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. sein → seines, Bruder → Bruders.

cards.front: The mother **of a friend** is a teacher.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. ein → eines, Freund → Freundes.

cards.front: **The children's** room is small.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. The plural genitive is der, and the noun keeps its plural form.

cards.front: **My parents'** house is old.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. Plural: meiner Eltern.

cards.front: The door **of the old** house is broken.
cards.back: Die Tür **des alten** Hauses ist kaputt.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. After des, the adjective takes -en: des alten Hauses.

cards.front: Berlin is the capital **of Germany**.
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. A name without an article just adds -s in the genitive: Deutschlands.

cards.front: **Whose** bag is that?
cards.note: The genitive: des Vaters, der Mutter. wessen: whose. In speech, Wem gehört die Tasche? is more common.

cards.front: Because of **the rain** we're staying at home.
cards.back: Wegen **des Regens** bleiben wir zu Hause.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. wegen takes the genitive: des Regens.

cards.front: Because of **the traffic jam** I'm late.
cards.back: Wegen **des Staus** komme ich zu spät.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. der Stau → des Staus. zu spät: too late.

cards.front: Because of **the strike** there are no trains running.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. der Streik → des Streiks.

cards.front: Because of **the noise** I can't sleep.
cards.back: Wegen **des Lärms** kann ich nicht schlafen.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. der Lärm → des Lärms.

cards.front: Because of **the delay** we arrived late.
cards.back: Wegen **der Verspätung** sind wir spät angekommen.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. die Verspätung → der Verspätung.

cards.front: Because of **my illness** I couldn't come.
cards.back: Wegen **meiner Krankheit** konnte ich nicht kommen.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. die Krankheit → meiner Krankheit.

cards.front: Because of **the weather** we didn't go hiking.
cards.back: Wegen **des Wetters** sind wir nicht gewandert.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. das Wetter → des Wetters.

cards.front: Because of **the exam** I'm studying a lot.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. wegen der Prüfung takes the first place; the verb follows.

cards.front: Because of **the price** I'm not buying the jacket.
cards.back: Wegen **des Preises** kaufe ich die Jacke nicht.
cards.note: wegen + genitive: because of. der Preis → des Preises: -es after s.
